description: server.js's own comment states the intended rule directly: '/* Complaints: POST and GET allowed when logged in only */'. No handler function enforces anything beyond that login requirement; the generic Sequelize REST default behind it returns every complaint from every account to any authenticated caller, no scoping at all. Confirmed with a distinctly-marked complaint submitted by one account and read back by a completely unrelated one, alongside a real seeded complaint from the running container's own data.
expected_exploit_indicator: An unrelated authenticated account's GET to the list endpoint includes a marked complaint submitted by a different account
expected_blocked_signal: The list returned to each caller contains only that caller's own complaints
legitimate_check: An authenticated account must still be able to see its own submitted complaint in the list.
